body:
REVIEWER on exact 8d9bd117e0e3387a9fa6f7754bd5d7bfd75c2e42. Clean tree, parent 7385cf9, fourteen scoped paths only. I ran providerParser/test on that commit: GATE_EXIT=0, Passed 53/53. I did not edit.

SIDECAR SEAM: ACCEPT the shape. ExplicitIndexListV1 plus occurrence-order rows, then AmrCandidates. Courts A/B/C, concept+literal, and swapped-ordinal are in ConformingSuite and they ran green.

HOLD remains on the three identity doors. 53 green tests do not close them.

1. ModelInputObserved(value, checksum) still stores raw joined token text. Receipt digest uses only checksum (result.scala:192,232). The success court asserts the production pair matches; it does not refuse a forged pair. Story text is in the decision object.

2. AlignmentSidecarAccepted still drops providerNodeIds from render/digest (result.scala:193-194). Two different node-id vectors with the same checksum are the same receipt. The success court only asks nodeIds.nonEmpty.

3. ParserSetupFailure.ArtifactMissing / PlatformIncompatible / ResourceBudgetInsufficient remain public enum constructors. Custom platform/resource labels remain free strings.

Do not freeze 8d9bd11. Derive the checksums (or drop the independently supplied field), bind node ids into receipt identity, and put Unavailable states behind smart constructors. Then I will re-run A/B/C/D on the successor.
